title: Quick Steaming Japanese Fish Ochazuke
description: A light and flavorful Japanese dish made with delicate fish, steamed to perfection over rice. Perfect for a romantic date night dinner.
instructions: Rinse the fish fillets under cold water and pat them dry with a paper towel.
Season the fish with a pinch of salt and a few drops of sesame oil.
Heat a tablespoon of sake (or dry white wine) in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of mirin and 1 tablespoon of soy sauce to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add 1 tablespoon of Thai fish sauce to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Pour the sauce into a small bowl and set aside.
Place the rice in a steamer basket over a pot of boiling water.
Steam the rice for 10 minutes, or until it's cooked and fluffy.
Place the fish fillets in the steamer basket with the rice.
Steam the fish for 3-4 minutes, or until it's cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Place a piece of fish on top of the rice and spoon some of the sauce over the fish.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve immediately.
